values.zh-CN: 条目 ID 与宏身份

content.markdown: Entry IDs come from real CLI readback, never abbreviations or assumed package prefixes; new IDs are marked proposed, every tree node is written `FULL_ID => <kind> title`, and a move keeps one ID under a different parent. Macros are identified by package, macro name, and style on both sides, and canonical names are not silently changed.
